messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group Meeting on February 13
messages.body_plain:

In 2026, the R Group will be reading Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs by Abelson, Sussman, and Sussman (1994, MIT Press) together.
The book is available online for free at: https://web.mit.edu/6.001/6.037/sicp.pdf<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fweb.mit.edu%2F6.001%2F6.037%2Fsicp.pdf&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7Cbf4b9149d3fb40fa3fab08de67e49b5d%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C639062428705743071%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Zhq7VzSlAJfenzKynszSRl7ztWQfElTKFJ8uJo0yt9w%3D&reserved=0>
